drafts.rationale: The evidence defines a bound on how many times a job may be executed so a job that cannot succeed does not consume workers forever.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: The evidence requires a fixed wait after a failed attempt before the job is delivered again, independent of attempt number.
drafts.subject: Orion job retry

drafts.rationale: The evidence bounds how long an individual execution may run before it is stopped and recorded as a failed attempt.
drafts.subject: Orion execution attempt

drafts.rationale: The evidence requires that further deliveries of an already-active job id be ignored without changing the active job.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: The evidence specifies how long Orion retains a producer-chosen idempotency key before a later delivery with that key is treated as new.
drafts.subject: Orion idempotency key

drafts.rationale: The evidence defines how long a worker lease lasts from delivery and that expiry without renewal or release makes the job available to other workers.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: The evidence specifies when a worker may renew a lease and that a renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the renewal moment.
drafts.subject: Orion worker lease

drafts.rationale: The evidence defines that cancellation prevents future execution attempts but does not interrupt an attempt already running.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: The evidence specifies that after the last unsuccessful attempt the job is moved to the dead-letter queue and is not executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.
drafts.subject: Orion job

drafts.rationale: The evidence defines when repeated dead-letter events for one tenant must raise an operator escalation, including how the time window is measured.
drafts.subject: Orion tenant dead-letter events

drafts.rationale: The evidence limits FIFO execution-order guarantees to jobs in the same queue partition and makes no ordering promise across partitions.
drafts.subject: Orion queue

drafts.rationale: The evidence specifies how long job state-transition audit events must be retained before they may be deleted.
drafts.subject: Orion audit event

drafts.rationale: EV-O-A01 and EV-O-A02 require a job to be executed at most three times in total, with the first execution counting as one of those three.
EV-O-A03 states each job begins with one initial execution and may then perform up to three retry executions, a different bound than three executions in total.

value.text: one initial execution plus up to three retry executions

drafts.rationale: EV-O-B01, EV-O-B02, and EV-O-B03 require the worker to wait exactly five seconds from the end of a failed attempt before every retry, without changing the wait by attempt number.
EV-O-C01 requires each attempt to time out after thirty seconds; EV-O-C02 and EV-O-C03 restate the same limit as half a minute, after which the execution is stopped and recorded as failed.
EV-O-D01, EV-O-D02, and EV-O-D03 require duplicate deliveries of an active job id to be ignored without altering the active job.

value.text: While a job id is active, further deliveries with that job id are ignored and must not change the active job's state.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-E01, EV-O-E02, and EV-O-E03 require each idempotency key to be retained for twenty-four hours after it is first seen, after which it may be forgotten.
EV-O-F01, EV-O-F02, and EV-O-F03 require a worker lease to last sixty seconds from delivery; on expiry without renewal or release the job becomes available to other workers.
EV-O-G01, EV-O-G02, and EV-O-G03 allow renewal every thirty seconds and require each renewal to extend the lease by the full lease duration from that moment.

value.text: A worker may renew every thirty seconds while work is progressing; each renewal extends the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-H01, EV-O-H02, and EV-O-H03 forbid starting further attempts after cancel while requiring a running attempt to continue to its own end.

value.text: After cancellation no future execution attempt may be started; an already running attempt is not interrupted and runs to completion, failure, or timeout.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-I01, EV-O-I02, and EV-O-I03 require automatic dead-lettering after the last unsuccessful attempt and forbid further execution unless the job is explicitly resubmitted.

value.text: After the final unsuccessful execution attempt the job is automatically moved to the dead-letter queue and must not be executed again unless explicitly resubmitted.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-J01, EV-O-J02, and EV-O-J03 require an operator escalation when three dead-letter events occur for one tenant within one hour measured from the first event.

value.text: Three dead-letter events for the same tenant within one hour, with the window measured from the first of the three events.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-K01, EV-O-K02, and EV-O-K03 guarantee first-in-first-out order only within a partition and make no ordering guarantee across partitions.

value.text: FIFO execution order is guaranteed only among jobs in the same queue partition; no ordering is guaranteed between different partitions.

drafts.rationale: EV-O-L01, EV-O-L02, and EV-O-L03 require audit events to be retained for thirty days after they are recorded and allow deletion thereafter.
